overview: Moomin is a Japanese European TV show about the inhabitants of a fictional place known as Moominvalley. The show follows Moomin and his parents Moominmamma and Momminpappa and their friends Sniff, Snufkin, Little My, Mr. Hemulen, Snorkmaiden and her inventor brother Snork.
title: Tanoshii Moomin Ikka

overview: Supernoobs is a Canadian animated series produced by DHX Media for Teletoon. The series is about four kids who navigate through middle school and fight evil assassins at the same time. It first premiered on Cartoon Network in the United Kingdom and Ireland on November 2, 2015. The series is created by Scott Fellows, who also created Johnny Test. 12-year-old nerdy best friends Kevin, Tyler, Shope and the Roach need to contend with the harrowing halls of their middle school while at the same time fight microcosmic assassins infecting earthlings bent on destroying them and the entire world.
title: Supernoobs
